I had a huge task in front of me: figure out how to escape the very business I had built to give me freedom.
I had followed all the rules. I'd built a successful client business, but in the process, I had accidentally made myself the single point of failure for everything.
Every new client meant less time. Every success meant another link in the chain tying me to my desk. My own ambition had burned the boats.
And faced with that, I had two choices. I could lean into the hustle, scale the grind, and accept that this was just the price of success.
Or, I could rebuild the entire thing from the ground up, with one non negotiable rule: the business had to run without me being in it every single day.
And I did it. I built the systems. I automated the operations. I got my time back, and more importantly, I got my life back.
I dealt with the hardship of letting go, of trusting systems over my own constant effort, and of redefining what success actually meant to me.
I'm not sure how I pulled it off, but I can tell you two things. It wouldn't have happened if I kept trying to be the hero, and it wouldn't have happened without leveraging AI and automation.
If you want to learn how to build these same systems for your business, I teach everything in my program, FieldWork. You can find the link in my bio.
